messages.subject: Notes on the shoot schedule
messages.body:
Hi,

I moved the lantern scenes to Saturday evening, so we get the river at dusk
instead of fighting the noon light. Sunday morning stays for the market
scenes. Can you check the cast is free both days?

Ana

messages.subject: Budget for the lantern shoot
messages.body:
Hey,

The venue came back at 4.2M for both days, a bit over what we planned.
I can trim the catering, or we drop the second camera on Sunday. The sheet
has both versions side by side. Which way do you want to go?

Rudi

messages.subject: Three actors confirmed for Saturday
messages.body:
Good news: Dewi, Bayu and Sari confirmed for Saturday evening. Their
headshots are attached, with the release forms they signed.

If the schedule moves again, let us know two days ahead so we can rebook.

The Casting Call team

messages.subject: Moodboard for the river scenes
messages.body:
Hi both,

Here are the frames I pulled for the river at dusk. Warm practicals,
lanterns low over the water, faces lit from below. The second frame is the
look I'd love for the opening.

Maya

messages.subject: Friday stand-up moves to 10:00
messages.body:
Hi all,

Friday's stand-up moves to 10:00, as the studio is booked until then.
Same room, same link.

Bayu

messages.subject: Voice-over takes for the promo
messages.body:
Hi,

I recorded the three reads you asked for: calm, warm and bright. My pick is
the warm one, but the bright read sits better under the music at the end.

Sari

messages.subject: Lighting at dusk without a crew
messages.body:
This week: how to light a scene at dusk with two practicals and a bounce,
why the blue hour is shorter than you think, and a reader's short film shot
entirely on a phone.

You get this because you subscribed to Studio Notes.

messages.subject: First cut of the market scene
messages.body:
Hi,

The first cut of the market scene is up. It runs 48 seconds; I think we can
lose the second wide shot and land closer to 40. Notes welcome before
Monday.

Dewi

messages.subject: Team lunch on Thursday?
messages.body:
Anyone up for lunch on Thursday after the review? The new place by the
river does a good nasi campur. Reply by Wednesday so I can book.

Rudi

messages.subject: Your rental invoice for October
messages.body:
Hello,

Your invoice for the October rentals is attached: one cinema camera kit and
two LED panels, for the 31st and the 1st. Payment is due on pickup.

Lensa Rentals

messages.subject: Script, second draft
messages.body:
Hi,

Second draft of the script attached. I cut the opening monologue down to two
lines and moved the lantern release to the very end, so the promo closes on
it. Tell me what you think of the last line.

Ana

messages.subject: October's picks: ten short films worth your evening
messages.body:
Ten short films from this month, from a two-minute animation about a paper
boat to a documentary on night markets. Each with a note on how it was made.

You get this because you subscribed to Frames Monthly.
